_about: Layout violations accepted on purpose. Each entry: page (a route like /holdings, or * for every page), rule (R1..R25), element (a piece of the element label shown in the report) and a reason. Only used by UI_LINT_STRICT=1 runs (npm run ui-lint) to pass; the report still lists them.

allow.reason: The three plan cards are a comparison: Free lists fewer features than Basic, and at 1280 px that shows as a shorter card. They start level, each ends at its own list with its button directly under it; stretching Free would only move the blank space inside it (R13), and filling it would be filler.

The two week cards sit side by side and start level. Late in a week the days already gone fold away, so 'This week' is a single 'Nothing left this week' line beside next week's list of companies. The page, its grid and its data were not changed by LIVE-1C; the gap follows the day of the week, and filling it would be filler.
